supercell-slam.cast: electricity surges: yellow zig-zag sparks (yellow #f8d030, orange #d09810, white) and dark storm cloud puffs gather above the Pokémon; frames 1-8 brighter; keep the middle half mostly empty
supercell-slam.effect: frames 1-4: ONE electrified body-slam rush, a yellow-white lightning wedge with crackling sparks, flying to the RIGHT, a loop; frames 5-8: it slams the target: a big yellow electric burst with white flash and sparks, fading

psychic-noise.cast: the Pokémon emits psychic sound: pink-violet sound waves (pink #f070b0, violet #a050e0, white) ripple around it; frames 1-8 they pulse; keep the middle half mostly empty
psychic-noise.effect: frames 1-4: ONE blast of pink psychic sound waves, curved pink-violet arcs with static lines, moving to the RIGHT, a loop; frames 5-8: it hits the target: pink rings pulsing around it with static, fading

upper-hand.cast: the Pokémon raises its hand fast: orange fighting energy (orange #f08040, red-brown #a83820, cream #ffd8a0) flashes on its palm on the right; frames 1-8 it builds then releases; keep the middle half mostly empty
upper-hand.effect: frames 1-4: ONE quick upward palm strike shape, an orange-white open hand with speed lines, flying to the RIGHT, a loop; frames 5-8: it strikes the target: an orange impact star with a palm-shaped flash, fading

malignant-chain.cast: a poisonous chain forms: purple chain links (purple #8040b0, violet #b070e0, dark #402060) coil around the Pokémon dripping toxin; frames 1-8 they tighten; keep the middle half mostly empty
malignant-chain.effect: frames 1-4: ONE purple poison chain whip with dark links and dripping toxin, flying to the RIGHT, a loop; frames 5-8: the chain wraps the target: purple chain coils and poison splash, fading
